prompt: Monobromination of 2-methylpropane (isobutane) with Br₂/hν. Draw the major product.

traps.note: Br₂ is highly selective for the 3° position (stable radical).

explanation: Br₂ is weak and selective — it strongly prefers the most stable radical (3°). The sole 3° C–H gives nearly all of the product as tert-butyl bromide.
